 Order

Dated this the 05th day of February, 2026 The 1st accused in Crime No. 258 of 2013 of Chemmangad Police Station now pending as L.P. No. 21 of 2023 on the file of the Fast Track Special Court, Koyilandy, filed this petition under section 528 of the B.N.S.S. praying for quashing all further proceedings against him.

The offences alleged against the petitoner and other accused persons are under Sections 376 and 498A of the IPC, Section 23 of the Juvenile Justice Act, Sections 9, 10, 11 and 15 of the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act and 7 and 8 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. The prosecution case is that the accused Nos. 2 to 14, who are the relatives of the victim, a minor,
colluded along with the 1 st accused to conduct the marriage of the victim with the 1 st accused and thereafter the 1st accused subjected the victim to sexual abuse and thereby he is alleged to have committed the aforesaid offences.

3. According to the learned counsel for the petitioner, there is absolutely no evidence to show that the victim involved in this case is a minor and as such as per Annexure A3 judgment, the learned Sessions Judge, Kozhikode, has already acquitted the other accused CRL.MC NO. 9247 OF 2025 2026:KER:10704 persons.
Therefore, the learned counsel prayed for quashing all proceedings against the petitoner also.
4. Though notice was served on the 2 nd respondent, she did not turn up.
5. The petition was opposed by the learned Public Prosecutor.

sentences.text: On a perusal of the Annexure A3 judgment in S.C No. 431 of 2018 dated 20.12.2022, it is revealed that when the victim and other witnesses were examined, the learned Sessions Judge found that there is no evidence to prove the age of the victim.

It was in the above context, as per Annexure A3,
accused Nos. 7 to 13 were acquitted.
Similarly, as per Annexure A2 order, the learned Special Judge discharged accused Nos. 2 to 6.
Since there is absolutely no evidence to prove that the victim was a minor, the offences under the provisions of the POCSO Act will not stand against the petitioner as well.

7. Since it is revealed that the accused Nos. 2 to 14 together conducted the marriage of the victim with the 1 st petitioner and the alleged sexual abuse was during the subsistence of the marriage between the petitioner and the victim, the offence alleged under Section CRL.MC NO. 9247 OF 2025 2026:KER:10704 376 of the IPC will not stand against the petitoner.
In the above circumstances, no useful purpose will be served in continuing proceedings against the petitioner and as such this Crl.M.C is liable to be allowed.
In the result, this Crl.M.C is allowed.

All further proceedings in Crime No. 258 of 2013 of Chemmangad Police Station now pending as L.P.
No. 21 of 2023 on the file of the Fast Track Special Court, Koyilandy.
